{{Top|leg}}
'''Rondium''' was a type of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], alongside the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] [[damotite]]. In order for damotite to be pure enough for use in [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd's]] [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[damotite bioweapon]], the rondium impurities had to be removed.<ref name="CWGSi">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>
